name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Studymate
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement

---

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of other ways to solve this problem?

## Does It Align With Project Goals?
How does this feature support Studymate's mission of privacy-first, accessible, open-source learning?

- [ ] Enhances privacy
- [ ] Works offline/locally
- [ ] Improves learning outcomes
- [ ] Increases accessibility
- [ ] Other: ___________

## Implementation Ideas
If you have technical ideas on how to implement this, share them!

## Priority
How important is this to you?
- [ ] Critical - Can't use the app without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples here.

## Willing to Contribute?
- [ ] Yes, I can help implement this
- [ ] Yes, I can help test this
- [ ] No, just suggesting the idea
